module_name: Creator Economy and Social Commerce Analytics
module_description: Module 24 covers monetization analytics: creator marketing measurement (impressions, CPE/CPM, engagement-per-follower), fake-follower and engagement-pod detection, affiliate and live-commerce performance (GMV, conversion, live viewer metrics), brand-creator matching, and disclosure/compliance analytics. It is the direct revenue-facing module of the course and connects to marketing majors in the program.
core_concepts: Creator marketing metrics and measurement standards
learning_outcomes: C3 Measure creator marketing performance honestly
C4 Compute engagement quality and flag fake-audience risk
methods_models: Engagement quality indices, fake-follower scoring, cohort/conversion analysis, uplift vs simple attribution
evaluation_metrics: Engagement rate and quality index, fake-follower rate, conversion rate, CPM/CPE, incremental lift where testable
pitfalls_limitations: Engagement pods inflating rates, self-reported metrics from agencies, unverifiable GMV, treat sponsorship as endorsement, selection bias in creator sets
tools_stack: pandas/scikit-learn, engagement-quality heuristics, optional API clients
tools_access_cost: Creator-marketplace platforms charge brands/agencies; free alternatives for student analysis
lab_activities: Assess 10 creators for a hypothetical brand campaign: audience overlap, engagement quality, and compliance
datasets_apis: Public creator metrics and disclosure-labelled posts
assessment_methods: Lab submission plus a short strategy recommendation memo; graded on metric validity and quality of reasoning
data_collection_workflow: Collect short-video metadata and media -> transcribe/OCR -> extract retention and engagement features -> normalise by follower base -> analyse and report
key_papers: 2024-2026 creator-economy market analyses (market size and growth; live-commerce growth)
trends_2024_2026: 2024-2026: creator economy crossed ~USD 250B and social commerce/live shopping became the growth channel, so measurement of creators and live conversion is now a core analytics skill
industry_relevance: Directly used in short-form content strategy, creator-marketing measurement, and social-commerce analytics teams; the metrics in this module (watch time, completion, saves, CTR via video) are the same KPIs agencies report to clients.
localization_context: Taught against the Indonesian short-video and live-commerce ecosystem (TikTok Shop, live shopping sessions, Shopee/Tokopedia live), which has different content formats and monetization mechanics from the US market.
ethics_regulation: Disclosure of paid partnerships, sponsored content and affiliate links; UU PDP and platform rules on scraping engagement data; caution when profiling creators and audiences from public metrics.
case_study_scenarios: Evaluate a creator campaign proposal with data: audience fit, quality of engagement, and compliance.
